title: Natural notes · all strings
description: Find and play a natural note on one specified string. Use frets 1–12; hints show its location.

cards.prompt:
Play C
on the low E string
cards.instruction:
String 6. Find it between frets 1–12.
Do not use the open string.
cards.hint: Press fret 8 on the thickest string (low E / string 6). That is C3.
